scope: Deliver GitHub-sourced tickets' milestone, blocker, evidence, PR-link and research-outcome updates as GitHub issue comments exactly once across retries and restarts; record the issue's open/closed state after a merge as the ticket's source status, separate from workflow state; optional in-progress/in-review workflow labels only when configured; undelivered updates visible with reason and retry. Schema 33 adds the github_updates outbox.

simulated.provider: Loopback GitHub REST fixture (axum in crates/crewroom-runtime/tests/github_delivery.rs); not github.com.
checks: comments_post_exactly_once_across_an_outage_a_lost_reply_and_a_restart: only the delivery reporter may queue; same event key returns the same intent, different content and unknown fields are refused; HTTP 503 leaves the update pending with its reason and nothing posted; a stored comment with a lost reply (502) is uncertain; after reopening the store and building a new outbox the marker confirms it with GitHub's comment id; a further pass posts nothing (1 post, 1 comment); CRLF bodies match; imported description and source status are unchanged; the coordinator receives a 'github' delivery notice

an_unknown_write_stays_uncertain_without_duplicates_until_the_operator_retries: a write that never landed (502) stays uncertain over three passes with one POST and the next update waits in order; a pending update cannot be retried; operator retry re-reads, posts once and both updates confirm (3 POSTs, 2 comments)

refusals_and_missing_credentials_are_undelivered_with_a_reason_and_retry: GitHub not connected leaves the update pending with the reason and no request; HTTP 403 blocks with 'Issues: Read and write' and the token is absent from the record; a blocked update is not resent by itself; retry after the fix confirms one comment

labels_apply_only_when_configured_and_the_merge_closes_the_issue_as_a_separate_fact: with labels off, in_progress is refused and a confirmed open PR derives nothing (no label writes); after configuring labels, in_progress adds the in-progress label and the open PR derives in_review (adds in-review, removes in-progress); after a merged publication the labels are removed and the merge observation stays pending 'Waiting for GitHub to close #1' with source status open; an unforced pass within a minute does not re-read; after the fixture closes the issue a reconcile confirms issueState closed, the ticket's sourceStatus becomes closed with GitHub's update time, run status/desiredState/purpose are unchanged and no comment was posted for labels or closure

Review fix (5f15de6), verified kinds against a ready Evidence/Research fixture (real run worktree through crewroom-process; the required check and passing review receipts recorded directly, no container runtime; readiness still assessed by Evidence::assess): evidence_and_pr_link_post_once_with_the_closing_sentence_across_a_lost_reply_and_a_reopen: evidence names the candidate revision and passed checks; pr_link is refused until a confirmed open GitHub PR exists, then links https://github.com/fixture/issues/pull/9 and ends with the GitHub closing sentence; the evidence reply is lost (uncertain) and the PR link waits in order; after a store reopen with new services the evidence is confirmed by marker and the PR link is recomputed at send time, matches what was queued (closing sentence included) and is posted once (2 POSTs, 2 comments, both labelled verified evidence). a_pr_link_whose_publication_changed_is_blocked_instead_of_posted: a queued PR link whose PR observation is no longer OPEN is blocked with 'The recorded evidence is no longer current.' and nothing is posted. a_research_outcome_holds_completion_until_queued_and_posts_once_after_completion: no outcome before completion is requested; after the coordinator requests completion needs_research_summary (the workflow's completion gate predicate) is true and the run stays running; once the reporter queues research-outcome-<revision> it is false; a flush while running leaves it pending with 'Waiting for confirmed research completion.' and no POST; after the team is stopped and research completes, a lost reply leaves it uncertain and a store reopen confirms it by marker (1 POST, 1 comment with the revision and artifact SHA-256 line)

Unit tests: every comment kind's label (agent report vs verified evidence), run line and stable marker; issue numbers only from #N keys; GitHub and Bitbucket PR links; provider-named refusals; issue-delivery remedies for 401/403/404/410/429 keep status and GitHub's message; loopback-only fixture origins; github_report/github_updates offered only with GitHub delivery, report only to the reporter or research-coordinator fallback; GitHub tickets use GitHub delivery and every other ticket keeps Jira

crewroom-core/tests/github_delivery.rs: labels off by default, validated, kept across a repository change and cleared; observed issue state changes only sourceStatus/sourceUpdatedAt and ignores older observations; GitHub receipts are kept apart from Jira and notify the coordinator; a schema-32 store gains the github_updates table

crewroom-service/tests/github_delivery.rs: labels need a saved repository (409), invalid labels 400, saved labels and the labels note are projected; workspace carries githubUpdates; /github/delivery/reconcile answers the outbox; retry of an unknown update is 404; no response carries the token. needs.rs unit test: blocked/uncertain GitHub updates appear under Needs you with their reason, superseded ones do not

Desktop: github_issues_tests.rs saves an in-review label through Settings and shows the labels note; results/tests.rs github_issue_delivery_is_listed_with_reasons_and_retry shows Delivered / Not delivered with reasons, the merge observation with GitHub's issue state, and Retry only for undelivered updates
